verdict.score_rationale: This lands on the 5 anchor because the board is readable and neatly gridded, but its repeated yellow text panels, sparse operational iconography, off-registry routing colors, and exposed edge mechanics make it feel like a flat working diagram rather than a finished artifact.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The two-row composition uses most of the width, but a conspicuous empty band remains beneath the lower row and the title occupies only a tiny corner of the oversized frame.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Fail: nearly every operational step is rendered as the same yellow panel despite yellow being reserved for human/message/event/key/coin objects, while purple and orange routes add off-registry decoration.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Fail: several colored routes terminate at exposed arrowheads near container boundaries, the red restart line ends abruptly, and multiple pill labels float over long wires rather than reading as securely anchored edge labels.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The four-column, two-row container grid holds consistently, but uniformly sized yellow text blocks and repeated internal placement create flat density with little deliberate visual hierarchy.
